verdict.rationale: ADK is an open-source framework (github.com/google/adk-python) that can be run locally via `adk run`, packaged into containers, and deployed to any environment supporting container images, or run fully offline/disconnected from Google Cloud, confirming genuine self-hosting of the core product. missing for 10: independent third-party confirmation of a full self-hosted production deployment outside Google's own docs/repo, and more detail on self-hosted persistence/scaling parity with managed Agent Runtime.
